definitions.gloss: side dish, prepared food, deli food
definitions.explanation: Pre-made dishes sold at supermarkets or specialty stores.

examples.japanese: スーパーで{惣菜|そうざい}を{買|か}う。
examples.english: To buy prepared food at the supermarket.

examples.japanese: {惣菜|そうざい}コーナーが{充実|じゅうじつ}している。
{惣菜|そうざい}パンを{買|か}う。
examples.notes: Bread with fillings like curry, ham, etc.

notes:
{惣菜|そうざい} refers to ready-made side dishes and prepared foods sold at supermarkets and deli shops.

POLITE FORM:
お{惣菜|そうざい} (osouzai) — commonly used in everyday speech.

COMMON TYPES:
- {煮物|にもの}: simmered dishes
- {揚|あ}げ{物|もの}: fried foods
- サラダ: salads
- {漬物|つけもの}: pickles

RELATED TERMS:
- {惣菜|そうざい}{屋|や}: deli shop
- {惣菜|そうざい}コーナー: deli section
- {惣菜|そうざい}パン: savory bread

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese supermarkets and department store basements ({デパ地下|デパちか}) are known for their extensive {惣菜|そうざい} selections.
